runtime_target_transport: none: offline, scripted models, no audio and no transport
provider_model_settings: pydantic-ai FunctionModel; ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False, so a real provider request raises rather than being made
command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_state
expected: Invalid defaults, results, batches and nested paths cannot partially commit
actual: All 24 checks passed. A part-failed batch leaves the previous state object in place (identity-checked, not just value-checked); nested assignment, a model_construct-ed instance and an authored bad default are all refused. Two negative controls were run while writing: reverting commit() to sequential assignment fails the batch check, and reverting the phone type to the old regex fails the short-number check.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.
The uncertain-external-write half of V5 is covered by tests.test_diary (operation token, outcome_of) against the in-memory fixture, not against a real service that can actually lose a response.
